summary: Practise reusable prompts, AI workflow design, and output checks for everyday business tasks. Explore the five-day prompt engineering bootcamp.
lede: Prompt engineering training helps non-technical professionals use AI assistants for recurring analysis, planning, communication, and reporting tasks. You’ll practise reusable prompt structures, few-shot analysis, and prompt chaining to create templates and sequence workplace tasks. The course also covers checking outputs against source material, reviewing assumptions and information sensitivity, and designing human review steps so managers, analysts, coordinators, and administrative staff can apply AI more consistently without coding.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for non-technical professionals who want to apply AI assistants to recurring workplace tasks and improve the quality and consistency of their outputs.
modules: NIST AI RMF and Responsible Use
prerequisites: Prerequisites: No programming or AI model development experience is required. You should be comfortable using workplace documents and spreadsheets and bring one recurring work task that you can discuss without sharing confidential information.
